description: Venture 9.2.2: faster question validation and lighter UI refresh. Local answer feedback no longer waits for full UI reconstruction or leaderboard sorting; local persistence and visible-panel refreshes are coalesced. Initial cloud history recovery runs without blocking the interface, while MQTT publishing still waits for history completion or a 4.5-second safety timeout. The existing write-ahead XP ledger remains synchronous and unchanged, preserving lifetime XP, account records, idempotent rewards, monthly leagues, duels, and All Star Kitchen with 55 source-mapped questions.
